articles.body: Volume XX is live from Carpentersville under mostly cloudy skies with a 20% shower chance (high near 62 / low around 53; ENE wind 10–15 mph, gusts to 20). Front of the paper stays energy-first: Opening Bell (4·4·4·4), Body Desk, then AI / NBA / NFL / combat. articles.hed: RESULT: Rams 28, Giants 6 — Donald Back, Dart Out Early
articles.deck: Stafford throws four TDs; Adams hauls in 195 yards and two scores. Jaxson Dart leaves in Q1 with a knee injury.
articles.body: On Monday Night Football, Los Angeles answered a rough Australia opener with a 28–6 statement win. Matthew Stafford threw for 327 yards and four touchdowns; Davante Adams caught eight for 195 and two scores. Aaron Donald returned to the NFL stage, and New York lost Jaxson Dart to a knee injury on the first offensive series — Jameis Winston finished 11-of-27 for 111 with a pick. Rams and Giants both sit 1–1. Carry competitive calm into Tuesday’s charge — then skim the board.

articles.hed: AI Desk: Grok 4.7 Ships; Peer Stress-Test Talks Surface
articles.deck: SpaceXAI pitches coding-and-knowledge Grok 4.7 at $2/$6 per million tokens; OpenAI and Anthropic reportedly discussed mutual model stress-tests.
articles.body: SpaceXAI launched Grok 4.7 (Sep 21) for coding and knowledge work — available in Cursor, Grok Build, and the API at the same starting rates as 4.6 ($2 input / $6 output per million under 200k context). Independent scoring and token-use debates already trail the release. Separately, reports say OpenAI and Anthropic held talks on a legally binding deal to stress-test each other’s models for hidden safety flaws. Full desks below.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Tuesday’s gate is cool radar and a clean second day — not the MNF scoreboard, not the kill clock. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Then own the middle of the week from the first breath.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not wait for dry radar or a perfect MNF rematch to start. Fierce calm is Tuesday composure when Monday Night already spent its noise: charge first, body second, security skim when ready, admin only after the morning has already won. One breath, one move, one clear next step. Competitors may still be replaying Stafford’s night or Dart’s exit; he arrives prepared for camp week and the midweek gate. When pressure rises, he slows the breath, names the next action, and outlasts the noise. Today is not about proving anything on the scoreboard. It is about banking competitive calm so Wednesday’s paycheck and Thursday’s Vegas gate have a clean operator behind them.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Tuesday: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Cool shower chance outside; tempo inside to open the midweek. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time. Optional: Front Clips / Back Clips if you want a second RipStick move.

Alchemists warned that the second day of heat decides the metal — not the spectacular first spark. Tuesday’s mystic job is to keep the forge lit with breath and body before any inbox ore cools the flame.

items.hed: Named Gates on a Midweek Path
items.body: Gnostic fragments prize the named gate. Today’s named thresholds are simple: Opening Bell, security skim, delivery watch, midweek map. Unnamed dread spreads; a named gate can be crossed once.

Esoteric athletes warned against spending the morning replaying Monday Night’s arena. Competitive calm is conserved force — charge and body first, then one security pass, then the week. Scatter is the cheap enemy of Tuesday power.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.body: “The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance, but everyone who is hasty comes only to poverty.” (Proverbs 21:5) Solomon’s counsel for a midweek morning is pace — diligence over haste, charge before admin. Tuesday’s breath and body are the diligent plan; security skim is the careful survey; Later / Admin is the house built only after the morning has already won. Classical lore cast Solomon as one who staged materials before the feast. Stage the morning the same way, so Wednesday’s paycheck and Thursday’s Vegas gate sit on prepared ground.
grimoire.practice: Finish Opening Bell and the 3-minute opener before any security skim, scoreboard replay, or admin. Diligent first; hasty later.

techDemo.title: Tech Demo
techDemo.kicker: Fast learn · from your X bookmarks
techDemo.pick: Delegate to a 24/7 GrokBot team — don’t operate the agent
techDemo.author: @0xRafy

image.alt: Newsprint diagram — Delegate, don’t operate: Computer + Memory + Tools → 24/7 agent team

lesson.oneLiner: Grok Bot already has its own computer, memory, and tools — your job is to delegate, not babysit the keyboard.
beats: Frame: “If you use GrokBot, it’s already their computer, not yours.”
Three pillars of a persistent agent: its own computer, its own memory, its own tools.
Behavior: it can keep working while you’re away — you don’t need to start every move.
Mindset flip: stop operating the agent; start delegating outcomes to it.
Same pattern as Dom’s desks: charge once → hand off the board → let the team run.
lesson.takeaway: Under a minute: treat Grok Bot as a standing teammate with computer/memory/tools, then assign the outcome instead of driving every click.
